releaseNotes: Buyer Log 7.0.193: PLM image jobs no longer fail every model one by one when the CoreNectum API token is missing or invalid; Buyer Log renews the PLM session automatically (silent SSO, then the CoreNectum login window) and retries once; if renewal still fails, the PLM User Sign-In screen opens (#250). CP image delete/update also revises the colour-named PLM image key so the old image no longer stays on screen (#249). Fixes: PLM Numune column source catalog entry, Partial View filter source and PLM request route module wiring. Includes everything in 7.0.192 (PLM sample requests in CP).
